{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cream structured blazer with a tailored fit, knee length, #f5f0eb, wool blend.
Pearl white silk blouse, relaxed collar, hip length, #fffdd0, satin.
Charcoal grey straight-leg trousers, full length, #36454f, heavy crepe.
Dark brown leather loafers, standard ankle height, #4a3b32, smooth calf leather.
Gold minimalist hoop earrings and a simple pearl necklace.
This outfit works because the structured blazer and polished trousers establish the required smart business tone for an office environment while remaining breathable for autumn temperatures. The cream and pearl tones harmonize beautifully with her warm skin undertones and hair color, creating a soft yet professional look. Adding loafers ensures comfort for a full day at work without sacrificing elegance or adherence to the dress code."}
